verdict.rationale: Rive's data binding and view models let colors, text, layouts and other properties connect to shared data that updates the scene automatically. That is a variable-like mechanism, but it is aimed at runtime data rather than design tokens. Nothing in the evidence describes a token or variable library, or modes and themes applied across designs. Missing for 10: explicit design tokens or variables for colors, spacing and typography; mode or theme switching across files or artboards; any hands-on or independent corroboration.
